title: Ladakh AB-PMJAY health assurance Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health assurance access for eligible Ladakh residents through the applicable PM-JAY/UT implementation framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current Ladakh beneficiary and PM-JAY/UT rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ladakh AB-PMJAY health assurance.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
